cohort: Very preterm infants born between 22 0/7 and 31 6/7 weeks of gestation, admitted to Qinghai Red Cross Hospital (QHH) and Shenzhen Baoan Women's and Children's Hospital (SZH) in China between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2020.
finding: Care practices for very preterm infants differed considerably between the QHH and SZH cohorts, with infants born in QHH having significantly higher odds of mortality or severe morbidity compared to those born in SZH.
